source_row.rationale: Bulk-forming laxatives (such as psyllium) work by absorbing water in the intestine to increase stool bulk and soften its consistency, promoting more natural peristalsis and generally having a gentler, slower onset of action, distinct from stimulant laxatives (such as senna or bisacodyl), which work by directly stimulating intestinal muscle contractions for a typically faster, though sometimes more cramping, effect.
source_row.source_detail: Comparison of Bulk-Forming vs. Stimulant Laxatives
